note: Written 2026-09-24 before any model output (docs/decisions.md D-007). Maps the 12 InfraredSolarModules classes to an IEC TS 62446-3 Class of Abnormality and a unified S-level for scoring. Truth is pattern-based because the 24x40 px crops carry no delta-T; a single hot cell is scored as CoA 2 (the conservative pattern reading), so a predicted CoA 3 on a hot-cell image counts as one grade off, not wrong.
